name: Nationale-Nederlanden San Silvestre Vallecana
summary: Iconic 10K through the heart of Madrid every New Year's Eve, with around 40,000 runners starting on Paseo de la Castellana near the Bernabéu and finishing at the Estadio de Vallecas.
heroNote: Paseo de la Castellana is wide and easy to access early on. Plaza de Cibeles, the Atocha glorieta, and Avenida de la Albufera entering Vallecas are the loudest spectator zones.
specialNote: The Popular race uses multiple start waves spread across the late afternoon. The listed start time is for the first wave — your actual start may be later.
